payload.title: Offline build: Emotion corpus, multi-class plumbing, labeler and metrics (S1-S8)
payload.description:
## Purpose

Make the unified harness run the Emotion corpus offline at $0, with the planted corpus still the default and byte-identical.

## Scope

S1 corpus config + replays; S2 Emotion loader/slices/stratified label order; S3 multi-class plumbing; S4 feature-budget cap + steering-prompt override; S5 Emotion labeler + fake; S6 cached zero-shot import + hash-equality spec; S7 macro-F1 metrics; S8 main-session dry run, replays, tests, push. Each step: spec first, no network, one Opus agent, reviewed by the main session. Pinned Jev-Flywheel clone `var/jev-flywheel-cd4a4886/` is read-only.

## Definition of done

Both planted replays (`var/unified-flywheel/phase2-live-seed1`, `seed2-live`) byte-identical after S1 and after S4; offline Emotion dry run with fakes passes (all arms, 3 x 150); `make test` and `make unified-flywheel-test` green; pushed.

## Cost cap

$0 (no live calls).

## Links

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md); [UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md)
